overloadMerges.note: offset's doc arrow is bidirectional (read as input offset, written back as new offset after the read) so direction must be 'inout', not the auto-derived 'in'; textFormat's 7 recognized constants are given explicit sentinelValues; textLength is only meaningful/required for the two 'without length' formats.

params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB from which to get the text

params.name: textFormat
params.description: Format and character set of the text to read

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset within the BLOB (expressed in bytes); on return, incremented by the number of bytes read

params.name: textLength
params.description: Number of characters to read; only used (and required) when textFormat is 'Mac text without length' (3) or 'UTF8 text without length' (6) -- ignored for the other formats, which self-describe their length

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reads and returns a Text value from a BLOB at a given (or default) byte offset, decoded per an explicit character-set/length format, and advances the offset variable by the bytes consumed.

constraints: The 'UTF8' format constants can only be used when the application runs in Unicode mode.
The 'Mac' format constants cannot work with texts greater than 32 KB.
